info.title: Distribo API
info.description: API for the Distribo delivery platform backend. Generated directly from the Zod schemas that validate each endpoint at runtime, so it always reflects the current API.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token returned by POST /auth/login or /auth/register/verify

200.description: The service is ready to accept traffic

503.description: The service is not ready (a dependency is unavailable)

post.summary: Register a new account (name + phone + password)

201.description: Account created; an OTP was sent to the phone number to verify it

message.example: Account created. Enter the verification code sent to your phone number.

post.summary: Verify the registration OTP and sign in

200.description: Phone number verified; account is now active and signed in

post.summary: Resend the registration OTP for an unverified phone number

202.description: Generic response — a new code was sent only if the phone number belongs to an existing, unverified, unlocked account

message.example: Account created. Enter the verification code sent to your phone number.

202.description: If the phone number is registered, a verification code has been sent

message.example: Account created. Enter the verification code sent to your phone number.

post.summary: Confirm a password reset with the OTP

message.example: Account created. Enter the verification code sent to your phone number.

post.summary: Request email verification for the signed-in account

202.description: Verification code sent to the provided email address

message.example: Account created. Enter the verification code sent to your phone number.

post.summary: Confirm email verification for the signed-in account

message.example: Account created. Enter the verification code sent to your phone number.
